column1: # Game profile of Toy Story: Retro Roundup! (Switch, update 1.0.4 = v262144; the second application of the Toy Story double-pack cartridge 01001DC025BC4000, picked with
# A collection of emulated retro games (PS1 discs under pancake/, SNES / GBC ROMs and replays under assets/) in an engine of its own on NVIDIA's desktop OpenGL through EGL: main imports
# the EGL functions and takes every GL call from eglGetProcAddress, which the host's GL layer answers on Metal (dm/gfx/gl/hle_gl.m), so NVIDIA's GL driver (subsdk0) is never loaded. SDK 21.4.4
# The shaders are GLSL sources in RIFF "SHDR" files (assets/shaders/*.shader: a gl43 hlslcc variant and an HLSL → SPIR-V → GLSL "gl" variant of each stage)
# subsdk1 is the movie player (main imports it), subsdk2 GLSLC; subsdk0 is NVIDIA's OpenGL driver, which programs the GPU through NvRm: never loaded, the GL layer answers main's EGL imports
# The NPDM declares 2 MB of system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true and main never sets a heap: nninitStartup's malloc setup (main+0x7e70) calls
# StandardAllocator::Initialize(nullptr, 0x1fa000000), a fixed 7.91 GB of address space made for the Switch's 64 GB alias region (main+0x2c8b00 → sdk+0x141ac0). The host's gate gives it
# what the alias region has room for, 4.06 GB, which fits after the SDK's 62 MB node area: SDK 21.4.4's AddressRegionManager constructor (sdk+0x14fbe0) takes the SDK-wide node area cut
# (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py; without it the 1 GB node area left no room, and CentralHeap::Init failed: an nn::diag abort at sdk+0x141b9c). Region placement aligns to 64 KB or 2 MB only
# (VammManager::AllocateAddressRegion, sdk+0x14fd00), so no alignment cut. Engage's 5 GB block: 256 MB in front + 4.375 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 2 MB of system resource
# no NVN shaders: the NVN tables stay empty (gl_shaders.py writes the GL library and its table, not the profile)

column2: Toy Story: Retro Roundup! has no NVN shaders (its GLSL shaders go through the GL layer)
